sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Aches as if top of head would fly off. Ar-
teries of forehead throb. Nose red.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Yellow; tongue yellow, coated, taking im-
print of teeth. [Merc.; Pod.; Rhus.]

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Sensation as if something hung down from
posterior nares ; cannot get it up or down.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Deep pain in right side over liver, going
through back. Stool yellowish brown, with bile.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Burning and swelling of the prepuce, with
redness of meatus. Gonorrhoea. [Cann.; Tussil.]
